summary: Frontend end-to-end testing of Vendor Booking feature on /vendors/v1 and /bookings. All 7 requested flows pass: (1) booking form + Calendar + package selection render with correct data-testids, (2) submit without a selected date shows an error toast, (3) selecting package-1 + an available future day via react-day-picker shows selected-date chip and POSTs to /api/bookings, navigates to /bookings/:id with status 'Requested' and all 4 timeline steps (timeline-pending/confirmed/in_progress/completed) visible, (4) new booking is remembered in localStorage and appears on /bookings as booking-card-<id>, (5) phone lookup with 9000000000 returns 3 seeded demo bookings, (6) unknown phone shows empty state, (7) Cancel booking sets status to Cancelled, timeline is replaced by cancelled notice, vendor calendar reloads successfully. Backend was previously curl-verified for availability, 409 double-book, 400 past-date, cancel-frees-date.
critical_code_review_comments: STATUS_FLOW uses 'pending' internally but STATUS_META label is 'Requested'. data-testid 'timeline-pending' is technically correct but slightly inconsistent naming — consider aligning either label or key to reduce cognitive overhead.
VendorProfile.jsx submit handler does not client-side validate phone format (accepts anything). Backend also does not; minor UX/data-quality issue.
BookingDetail cancel() uses generic 'Could not cancel. Try again.' toast without surfacing server error detail (unlike VendorProfile which surfaces err.response.data.detail).
MyBookings loadLocal never sets loading=false when ids.length is 0 path is fine, but the axios .catch swallows errors silently — no user-visible error state on API failure.
getRememberedBookings has no cap; over time localStorage may grow unbounded. Consider trimming to last N ids.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 booking via UI (Test User / 9111111111 / Full Wedding pkg on 11 Sept 2026) then cancelled it — vendor date released.
context_for_next_testing_agent: react-day-picker v8: enabled day buttons selectable via '.rdp button[name="day"]:not([disabled])'. Navigate months via button[aria-label*=next]. selected-date chip appears immediately on click. Booking IDs are UUIDs; ref is AW-XXXXXX. Booking cancel button hidden on non-active statuses (cancelled/completed).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in booking feature.
